item.title: San Diego vigil organized for slain registered nurse Alex Pretti
item.description: National Nurses United is hosting a week of actions to honor Alex Pretti, a registered nurse killed by federal agents in Minneapolis.

item.title: Amber Alert issued for 2 children missing from Santa Clarita, suspect in black Sorento
item.description: The California Highway Patrol issued an Amber Alert early Thursday for two abducted children and an adult suspect last seen in Los Angeles County.

item.title: Local vegan cookie shop bakes celebratory cookies to honor Black History Month
item.description: Maya's Cookies, a Black-owned vegan cookie company in San Diego, has launched its 2026 Black History Month Collection, 'The Continuity of Culture', featuring three specially crafted cookies inspired by Magic Johnson, Amanda Gorman, and Patti LaBelle.

item.title: San Diego Zoo Safari Park offering free admission for seniors
item.description: People aged 65 and older can visit the San Diego Zoo Safari Park in Escondido for free all month long in February.

item.title: 10 romantic San Diego restaurants to celebrate Valentine's Day
item.description: San Diego restaurants are offering special Valentine's Day dinners, ranging from steak dinners to heart-shaped pizzas and desserts.

item.title: San Diego police ramp up enforcement on illegal e-motorcycles ridden by teens
item.description: San Diego police are ramping up enforcement of high-powered electric motorcycles being ridden illegally on city streets, often by teenagers, due to safety concerns and a high number of complaints from neighborhoods across the city.

item.title: Car slams into semi tractor-trailer in Torrey Pines, driver seriously injured
item.description: A driver was severely injured after a car crashed into the back of a semi-truck in La Jolla, prompting a heavy rescue effort and a SIG Alert due to traffic impacts in the area.

item.title: Public's help wanted in finding 21-year-old missing woman from North County
item.description: The San Diego County Sheriff's Office is seeking public assistance in locating 21-year-old Jada Morrison, who was last seen in 4S Ranch on Dec. 21 and has since been spotted in Oceanside and Hayward, California.

item.title: 'I have to fight cancer and now to get care': Lakeside mom affected by Kaiser strike
item.description: A stage four breast cancer patient is speaking out against the Kaiser Permanente strike, which has disrupted her treatment, while another union is preparing to join the picket line.
